prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: vertical bitmap TEXTURE SOURCE for a Kalistar collaboration banner, NOT a finished card or UI. Portrait aspect roughly 1:2.3.
References 1 and 2 show the existing FF8 source banner and tiny final flag solely as material/readability references. Create a matching premium material treatment for FINAL FANTASY X, but DO NOT repeat FF8 lovers, text or red palette.
Main heraldic motif: the recognizable Final Fantasy X Yuna sending silhouette with long sweeping wave/flame and ribbon strokes around her, elegant readable ornamental emblem, transitioning from warm sunrise ORANGE above through gold to ocean TURQUOISE and BLUE below, as the characteristic FFX logo illustration. A calm luxurious DARK NAVY woven silk field with subtle fabric texture, small copper trim only within the cloth. Center one large bold silhouette emblem, simplified enough to read when the image is fitted to about 98x223 pixels. Let the orange/cyan sweeping motif occupy the central upper-middle zone and breathe.
IMPORTANT: texture source with a clean long cloth panel, gentle shallow folds only, no detached tassels, no pole, no rods, no separate hardware, no ornament outside the fabric. The existing approved banner alpha will provide the final pointed silhouette; do not invent a complicated silhouette or outer shadows. No lettering, no FF8 symbol, no card border, no background scene. Navy and orange/turquoise contrast must remain legible when tiny. Painterly premium textile and lightly embossed colored emblem, not a smooth flat vector logo.
Reference 3 is the OFFICIAL Final Fantasy X logo: reproduce its actual recognizable Yuna sending figure on the left, sweeping long sleeves/ribbons and great curling wave/soul flourish to the right as an embroidered emblem, without any of the black FINAL FANTASY lettering. Honor the supplied shape rather than inventing a generic X. Adapt its wide motif intelligently to the vertical cloth by centering Yuna and gathering the sweeping flourish below/right, preserving recognizable gesture and fluid silhouette. Match its cyan/blue left-to-gold/orange right coloration. No typography.
